central_dramatic_question: Can protective trust calm what violence is trying to weaponize?
protagonist_need_arc: Mira moves from refusing attachment to choosing public, costly protective love.

sequences.turn: Mira's hiding place becomes a rescue site
sequences.protagonist_choice: cut the child free despite exposure
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: the child's fear can raise stormglass walls
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: child imprints on Mira after protection
sequences.visual_setpiece: black-water net rescue and first storm wall
sequences.sound_design_intent: near-silent creature cry under rope creaks, then storm sub-bass
sequences.retention_hook: why does the navy hunt a child whose fear controls weather?

sequences.turn: Mira is recognized by the burn scar
sequences.protagonist_choice: abandon her safe lighthouse cover and flee inland
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: the child calms when Mira hums the old beastkeeper lullaby
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: young ferryman Tam chooses to help after seeing the child spared
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: Mira admits she once protected the royal nursery
sequences.visual_setpiece: cliffside lighthouse escape as lantern ships sweep the rocks
sequences.sound_design_intent: lullaby close and intimate against distant engine thrum
sequences.retention_hook: the admiral brands Mira a kidnapper and offers a public bounty

sequences.turn: the child refuses food because captivity trauma makes it fear metal
sequences.protagonist_choice: Mira removes her protective gloves and lets the child bite/bond with her scarred hand
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: the child projects memory-images through its glass scales
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: Tam shifts from profit motives to genuine ally
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: memory shows Admiral Rook ordering the nursery fire
sequences.emotional_shift: dread to tenderness and moral certainty
sequences.visual_setpiece: memory-light cave filled with floating images of the nursery fire
sequences.sound_design_intent: drop music for the bite; heartbeat and scale chimes carry the moment
sequences.retention_hook: they now possess proof, but no one will believe a disgraced exile

sequences.turn: villagers shelter them until the bounty makes neighbors afraid
sequences.protagonist_choice: Mira surrenders her last royal token to buy boats for evacuation rather than her own escape
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: stormglass shards react to collective fear in the village
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: village elder Ilsa becomes a protective witness
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: Mira learns the king believes she murdered the nursery creatures
sequences.sound_design_intent: whispered crowd fear, water drips, child whimper as rhythmic tension
sequences.retention_hook: navy ships arrive before the evacuation completes

sequences.turn: Tam apparently betrays their route, causing Mira and the child to be captured
sequences.protagonist_choice: Mira chooses to shield the child rather than attack Tam or escape alone
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: the child's pain can crack stormglass and destroy ships
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: Mira's trust in people is shattered even as her bond with the child deepens
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: Rook reveals he plans to force the child to open a storm channel for invasion
sequences.emotional_shift: communal hope to betrayal and captivity
sequences.visual_setpiece: iron containment chamber where every lash of fear fractures the walls
sequences.sound_design_intent: music cuts out when the child is restrained; metal and breath dominate
sequences.retention_hook: Tam is shown slipping a copied key into his sleeve

sequences.turn: Tam's betrayal is revealed as infiltration, but Mira must choose whether to trust him again
sequences.protagonist_choice: she accepts Tam's help without forgiving him yet and frees other captured sea creatures first
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: freed creatures can carry the memory-proof to the capital witnesses
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: Mira, Tam, and the child become a coordinated found-family unit
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: the child recognizes the mother-call beneath the capital storm vault
sequences.emotional_shift: betrayal to fragile trust and purpose
sequences.visual_setpiece: multi-creature escape through storm-lit ship canals
sequences.sound_design_intent: lullaby motif returns broken, then harmonizes with creature calls
sequences.retention_hook: the child may not be the last: its mother or sibling is imprisoned below the capital

sequences.turn: Rook uses the imprisoned parent creature to weaponize the storm channel
sequences.protagonist_choice: Mira enters the vault publicly rather than fleeing, forcing witnesses to see who truly protects the creatures
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: calm bonding can reverse the weaponized storm channel
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: villagers and sailors begin defending Mira after seeing the memory-proof
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: the king witnesses Rook's confession through the child's projected memories
sequences.visual_setpiece: storm vault opens over the capital as parent and child call across chaos
sequences.sound_design_intent: massive storm drops into silence for the child's answering call
sequences.retention_hook: Mira must reach the parent before Rook collapses the vault

sequences.turn: the creatures calm the storm only after Mira releases control and trusts them
sequences.protagonist_choice: she refuses to use the child's power even to win, breaking the weaponization logic
sequences.new_capability_or_clue: the stormglass network responds to sanctuary rather than command
sequences.ally_or_relationship_change: Mira is publicly restored and chooses a communal coastal home rather than royal rank
sequences.secret_reveal_escalation: the surviving parent remains free by treaty, not captivity
sequences.emotional_shift: sacrificial tension to relief, warmth, and belonging
sequences.visual_setpiece: sunlit stormglass arch over the sea as child and parent fly free
sequences.sound_design_intent: lullaby completed by child/parent calls, then human celebration underneath
sequences.retention_hook: final warmth and restoration rather than sequel dependency

midpoint_reversal: Tam's apparent betrayal delivers Mira and the child to Rook, converting a fugitive protection story into a captive weaponization crisis while secretly planting the key to later trust repair.

ending_payoff.justice: Rook is publicly exposed by creature memory evidence and his own weaponization attempt, not by hearsay.
ending_payoff.belonging: Mira, the child, Tam, villagers, and freed creatures form a chosen protective community; the child is safe by bond rather than ownership.
ending_payoff.future_image: Mira watches parent and child fly freely through a sunlit stormglass arch while the coastal home lights its first peaceful beacon.

anti_patterns_checked: no diffuse spectacle before relational anchor
no abstract lore before wound/protection loop
no repetitive suffering without capability or relationship progression
